productConcept.name: Vellum & Iron
productConcept.description: Bespoke bookbinding and archival restoration studio in the Pacific Northwest, est. 1994, serving rare book collectors, private archivists, and institutions.
productConcept.rationale: The Tidal Grain aesthetic — editorial restraint, percussive section cuts, material intimacy through video, warm off-white surfaces — maps naturally to a craft studio where objects carry temporal depth. The macro drift video brief and the material-specificity language in concept_by_image.md pointed toward a domain where time and craft are inseparable from the product.
